args.title: Triage issue #4410: update config.ts
args.body:
File: src/config.ts

Proposed change: address the reported issue in this file.
Evidence: int() uses Number.parseInt(raw, 10), which parses leading digits (e.g. "12h" -> 12) without validating that the entire string was consumed, allowing invalid formats like "12h" or "1h" to be silently accepted as numbers.

args.title: Triage issue #4423: update index.ts
args.body:
File: src/i18n/index.ts

Proposed change: address the reported issue in this file.
Evidence: The pickLocale function in src/i18n/index.ts splits the Accept-Language header by comma and checks each part in order, ignoring q-values (quality values), which causes headers like en;q=0.3, fr-FR;q=0.9 to pick English instead of French.
